text.yunbeiuc.sign_speed_limit.title: Speed Limit Selection
text.yunbeiuc.sign_speed_limit.descripti: Indicates that within the section from this sign to the sign indicating the lifting of the speed limit ahead or another speed limit sign with a different limit, the speed of motor vehicles [in kilometers per hour (km/h)] must not exceed the value shown on the sign.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_cancel_speed_limit.de: Indicates the end of a speed limit zone. It is placed at the end of a road section where vehicle speed is restricted. The sign has a white background, a black circle, a thin black diagonal line, and black text. The speed limit cancellation sign should be used in conjunction with the speed limit sign. When another speed limit sign with a different speed value is used to indicate the end of the previous speed limit zone, this sign may not be necessary.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_entry_for_vehicles: Indicates that non-motor vehicles are prohibited from entering. It is placed at the entrance of sections where non-motor vehicles are not allowed. When prohibiting specific types of non-motor vehicles from entering, auxiliary signs should be used for clarification.
Indicates that large (or small) passenger vehicles are prohibited from entering. Placed at the entrance of sections where large (or small) passenger vehicles are not allowed.
Indicates that vehicles transporting dangerous goods are prohibited from entering. It is placed at the entrance of road sections where vehicles carrying dangerous goods are not allowed to enter.
Indicates that tricycles are not allowed to enter. Placed at the entrance of roads where tricycles are prohibited.
Indicates that all vehicles and pedestrians are prohibited from passing. Placed near the entrance of roads where all vehicles and pedestrians are prohibited.

Indicates that trailers and semi-trailers are prohibited from entering. It is placed at the entrance of road sections where trailers and semi-trailers are not allowed. If there are specific prohibitions for certain types of trailers, an auxiliary sign should be used to provide clarification.
Indicates that pedestrians are prohibited from entering. Placed in areas where pedestrians are not allowed to enter.
Indicates that rickshaws are prohibited from entering. Placed at the entrance of a section where rickshaws are not allowed.

Indicates that all vehicles are prohibited from entering (including non-motor vehicles). It is placed at the entrance of the road section where entry is forbidden. Its color is a red background with a white horizontal bar in the center. It can be set repeatedly as needed, and when set repeatedly, the distance between two 'No Entry' signs should be 60m to 150m.

Indicates that trucks are prohibited from entering (including special cargo operation vehicles). It is placed at the entrance of the road section where trucks and special cargo operation vehicles are prohibited from entering. When there are load limits or other restrictions for entering trucks and special cargo operation vehicles, an auxiliary sign should be used to indicate such restrictions.
Indicates that motorcycles are prohibited from entering. Placed at the entrance of sections where motorcycles are not allowed.
Indicates that large (or small) passenger vehicles are prohibited from entering. Placed at the entrance of sections where large (or small) passenger vehicles are not allowed.
Indicates that draft animals are prohibited from entering. It is placed at the entrance of roads where draft animals are not allowed.

Indicates that human-powered tricycles carrying passengers or goods are prohibited from entering. It is placed at the entrance of the road section where human-powered tricycles carrying passengers or goods are not allowed to enter.
Indicates that electric bicycles are prohibited from entering. Placed at the entrance of sections where electric bicycles are not allowed.
Indicates that three-wheeled vehicles and low-speed trucks are prohibited from entering. Placed at the entrance of sections where three-wheeled vehicles and low-speed trucks are not allowed.

Indicates that all types of motor vehicles are prohibited from entering. It is placed at the entrance of the section where motor vehicles are prohibited. If there are prohibitions based on time, vehicle type, or other conditions, an auxiliary sign should be added to provide an explanation.
Indicates that all types of tractors are prohibited from entering. It is installed at the entrance of the road section where all types of tractors are prohibited from entering.

Indicates that human-powered tricycles carrying passengers or goods are prohibited from entering. It is placed at the entrance of the road section where human-powered tricycles carrying passengers or goods are not allowed to enter.

Indicates that within a limited area, all vehicles are prohibited from stopping or parking, regardless of whether the driver stays with the vehicle. The sign is placed in locations where vehicles are prohibited from stopping or parking and has a blue background with a red circle and a red diagonal slash. The angle between the sign and the driving direction should be 30°–45°. Either the sign or road markings may be used. If there is a possibility that the road markings may be obscured by snow or other reasons, this sign should be installed.

Indicates that within a limited area, long-term parking or stopping of all vehicles is prohibited, while temporary parking is not restricted. The sign is placed in areas where long-term stopping or parking is prohibited, with a blue background, red circle, and red diagonal slash. Temporary parking refers to stopping the vehicle to pick up or drop off passengers or to load and unload goods, with the driver waiting in the vehicle or nearby. The angle between the sign and the driving direction should be 30°~45°. Either the sign or road markings can be used. If road markings may be covered by snow or become otherwise invisible, the sign should be installed.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_direction.title: No Direction Selection
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_direction.sign_no_: Indicates that all vehicles are prohibited from turning left (or right) at the upcoming intersection. It is placed before intersections where left (or right) turns are prohibited.
Indicates that all vehicles are prohibited from turning left (or right) at the upcoming intersection. It is placed before intersections where left (or right) turns are prohibited.
Indicates that all vehicles are prohibited from going straight at the upcoming intersection. Placed before intersections where going straight is prohibited.
Indicates that all vehicles are prohibited from turning left or right at the upcoming intersection. Placed before intersections where left and right turns are prohibited.

Indicates that all vehicles are prohibited from going straight and turning left (or going straight and turning right) at the upcoming intersection. It is placed before an intersection where going straight and turning left (or going straight and turning right) is prohibited.

Indicates that all vehicles are prohibited from going straight and turning left (or going straight and turning right) at the upcoming intersection. It is placed before an intersection where going straight and turning left (or going straight and turning right) is prohibited.
Indicates that motor vehicles are prohibited from making U-turns. It is installed at the beginning of the section where U-turns are prohibited and in front of intersections.

This sign indicates that motor vehicles are not allowed to overtake within the section of road from this sign to the 'End of No Overtaking' sign. It is placed at the beginning of the no overtaking section and can be repeatedly set within the no overtaking section as needed.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_direction.sign_can: Indicates the end of a no-overtaking zone. It is placed at the end of a no-overtaking section, with a white background, black circle, black thin diagonal stripe, and black graphic. This sign should be used in conjunction with the no-overtaking sign.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_height_limit.title: Height Limit Selection
text.yunbeiuc.sign_height_limit.descript: Indicates that vehicles with an overall height exceeding the value shown on the sign are prohibited from passing. It is set in places where the maximum allowable height is restricted. In areas with restricted maximum allowable height, if vehicle collisions are likely to occur and such collisions could affect structural safety, in addition to setting height limit signs, facade markers and other warning facilities may be installed at the sign location.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_width_limit.title: Width Limit Selection
text.yunbeiuc.sign_width_limit.descripti: Indicates that vehicles with an overall width exceeding the value shown on the sign are prohibited from passing. It is set in places where the maximum allowable width is restricted. This sign is not required when the road’s clear width meets standard specifications. On road sections where this sign is installed, it is advisable to place corresponding directional signs at the entrances to the section to indicate a detour.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_weight_limit.title: Weight Limit Selection
text.yunbeiuc.sign_weight_limit.descript: This indicates that vehicles with a total mass exceeding the value shown on the sign are prohibited from passing. It is placed at both ends of bridges where vehicle weight needs to be restricted. On sections where this sign is set up, it is advisable to place corresponding guide signs at intersections before entering the section, allowing vehicles with a total mass exceeding the value shown on the sign to detour in advance. If, after inspection, testing, and reinforcement, the bridge cannot meet the requirements of the bridge design specifications, this sign needs to be installed at both ends of the bridge, with the value determined based on the results of testing and assessment. The following situations may not require this sign: a) vehicles prohibited from carrying loads by law; b) the bridge meets the corresponding design specifications.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_special.title: Special Sign Selection
It means that vehicles must stop completely before entering the intersection and confirm safety before passing. Parking and yielding signs should be set separately. The shape of the logo is a regular octagon, and the color is white letters on a red background. When there is a pedestrian crossing line at the intersection, the parking yield sign should be set in front of the pedestrian crossing line, 2m~3m away from the edge of the pedestrian crossing line, and should not hinder the sight distance of the crossing triangle.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_special.sign_yield: It means that the intersecting road has the right of way, and the vehicle should drive slowly or stop, observe the driving situation of the intersecting road, and let the vehicles on the intersecting road give priority to pass and confirm safety before passing. The deceleration and yield signs should be set separately. The shape of the logo is an inverted equilateral triangle, and the color is white background, red edge, and black letters. When there is a pedestrian crossing line at the intersection, the deceleration yield sign should be set in front of the pedestrian crossing line, 2m~3m away from the edge of the pedestrian crossing line, and should not hinder the sight distance of the crossing triangle.

It means that when the vehicle meets the car, it should stop and let the other car go first. The shape of the logo is circular, and the color is red circle on a white background, red and black arrows. In the following situations, except for signal light control, a meeting car yield sign should be set up: one end of a narrow road section where it is difficult to meet a vehicle; Two-way roads can only open one lane for two-way traffic for some reason, and the restricted end of the road.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_special.sign_no_ho: It means that vehicles are prohibited from honking. It is set up in a place where it is necessary to prohibit vehicles from honking. The period and range of prohibited honking can be explained by auxiliary signs.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_special.sign_check: It means that motor vehicles should be stopped for inspection. It is located in a place where motor vehicles need to be parked for inspection. When there are vehicle type regulations and reasons for parking inspection, auxiliary signs should be applied or instructions should be attached to the sign, and the horizontal bar should remain unchanged, indicating that the motor vehicle needs to be parked for port inspection.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_no_special.sign_port_: It means that motor vehicles should be stopped for inspection. It is located in a place where motor vehicles need to be parked for inspection. When there are vehicle type regulations and reasons for parking inspection, auxiliary signs should be applied or instructions should be attached to the sign, and the horizontal bar should remain unchanged, indicating that the motor vehicle needs to be parked for port inspection.
Indicate One-way Street Left and Right

Indicates that the road ahead is for straight-ahead travel, and vehicles should maintain a straight line. Placed at an appropriate location before an intersection where it is necessary to indicate the straight-ahead direction.
Indicates that the road ahead allows left turns, and vehicles may turn left. Placed at an appropriate location before an intersection where it is necessary to indicate the left-turn direction.
Indicates that the road ahead allows right turns, and vehicles may turn right. Placed at an appropriate location before an intersection where it is necessary to indicate the right-turn direction.

Indicates that the road ahead allows straight travel or left turns, and vehicles may choose to go straight or turn left. Placed at an appropriate location before an intersection where it is necessary to indicate the straight or left-turn direction.

Indicates that the road ahead allows straight travel or right turns, and vehicles may choose to go straight or turn right. Placed at an appropriate location before an intersection where it is necessary to indicate the straight or right-turn direction.

Indicates that the road ahead allows left or right turns, and vehicles may choose to turn left or right. Placed at an appropriate location before an intersection where it is necessary to indicate the left or right-turn direction.

Indicates that there is a median strip on the left side of the road, used to separate opposing traffic. Placed at the start of the median strip on the left side of the road or at a location where indication is needed.

Indicates that there is a median strip on the right side of the road, used to separate traffic in the same direction. Placed at the start of the median strip on the right side of the road or at a location where indication is needed.

Indicates that there is a roundabout intersection ahead, and vehicles should travel around the roundabout in a clockwise direction. Placed at an appropriate location before the roundabout intersection.
Indicates that the road ahead is a one-way street, and vehicles may only travel in the straight direction. Placed at the entrance to the one-way street or at a location where indication is needed.
Indicates that the road ahead is a one-way street, and vehicles may only travel to the left or right. Placed at the entrance to the one-way street or at a location where indication is needed.
text.yunbeiuc.sign_indication_lane_direc: Indicates the direction of travel for lanes at intersections. It should be placed at an appropriate location before the guiding lanes. It is advisable to install it above the lanes being indicated. When it is not possible to align directly with the lanes, it should be installed in combination with other signs. When setting up lane direction signs, directional arrows such as straight, turn, and U-turn should be painted on the road surface of the lanes, and the ground directional arrows should be consistent with the indications on the signs. When intersections have special traffic organization or management requirements, lane direction signs can be designed according to actual conditions.
Straight and Left Turn Shared Lane
Straight and Right Turn Shared Lane
U-turn and Left Turn Shared Lane
text.yunbeiuc.sign_guide_intersection_ad: Used to indicate the type of upcoming intersections, the number or name of intersecting roads, the directions to be taken, and route directions. There are three types of intersection advance warning sign layouts: diagram type, stacked type, and lane type. On advance warning signs for T-intersections, crossroads, and roundabouts, guidance information for left and right directions should be placed below the lanes or at the ends of the lanes, not above the lanes, as shown in the diagram type of intersection. On roads with larger spacing between intersections and higher speeds, intersection advance warning signs may include distance information to the upcoming junctions.
